title: Guests, Family and Guest Passes in Crestline Summit Club Lounges — Desk Training Note
content:
**The rule.** Under the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships, a member may bring at most the membership's guest ceiling on one visit. The first guests up to the membership's number of included guests enter free; further guests use a guest pass or pay the membership's guest entry fee each, and the guest fees for one visit are charged together as one guest entry fee charge. With family access, the member's spouse or domestic partner and children younger than the membership's family age enter free and do not count as guests; on every membership, children younger than the membership's free-entry age for children enter free. The membership's yearly number of guest passes is granted at the start of each membership year, and each grant expires the membership's pass validity in calendar months after the grant. A pass admits a guest without the member only when the membership allows it. Guest passes are used only while the membership is active. Unused passes are forfeited when the membership lapses or is cancelled, when the membership provides for that forfeiture.

The guest ceiling, included guests, guest entry fee, family access and ages, yearly passes, pass validity, use without the member and forfeiture are set per membership.

## Questions answered from the rule

**Who counts toward the guest ceiling?**
Guests entering with the member. Under family access, the spouse or domestic partner and children younger than the family age enter free and do not count as guests.

**Which guests pay?**
None of the included guests. Each guest beyond them is admitted either with a guest pass or on payment of the guest entry fee.

**How are the fees for one visit charged?**
Together, as one guest entry fee charge for that visit, not as one charge per guest.

**When may a guest pass be used?**
Only while the membership is active, as recorded on the membership itself. A pass admits a guest arriving without the member only on a membership that allows use without the member.

**What moves the member's guest pass balance?**
The yearly grant at the start of each membership year adds passes; guest entries using passes and the expiry or forfeiture of unused passes deduct them.

**When does a granted pass expire?**
The stated number of calendar months after the grant. Hypothetical: with a validity of 12 calendar months, passes granted on 1 September 2025 expire on 1 September 2026.

## One visit, worked (hypothetical membership: guest ceiling 3; 1 included guest; guest entry fee 60 USD; member holds guest passes)

| Guests entering with the member | Free as included | Further guests | Charge for the visit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 0 | none |
| 3; one further guest uses a guest pass, the other pays | 1 | 2 | one guest entry fee charge of 60 USD, and one pass deducted |
| 3; both further guests pay | 1 | 2 | one guest entry fee charge of 120 USD (60 USD each, charged together) |
| 4 | — | — | beyond the ceiling of 3 guests on one visit |
